title: ID0480068-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S0 170004173] Sidewall of the charger got damaged
description:
Reported behavior/issue-
Sidewall of the charger got damaged
Note from RC:
The damage was assessed on-site. The following findings were noted:
The door could be rehung. However, the rear door, including its hinges, and the side door, also including its hinges, are damaged.
It was also discovered that a short circuit had occurred in the circuit breaker. Alexander detected in the backend that the main switch had tripped. This was reset, as there is currently no immediate danger. The system is equipped with an insulation tester, which provides additional protection.
Nevertheless, the circuit breaker should be checked as a precaution to determine whether replacement is advisable.
I am attaching photos documenting the damage. These can serve as a basis for ordering the necessary replacement parts for the customer.
Once the parts arrive, we will be happy to assist you with the further work.

Hi Alex, good afternoon.
According to the information and the photos shared, I recommend to preventively shutdown the charger and make a risk assessement to ascertain that we have safe conditions to operate, taking into consideration the photo that show us a potential short circuit between a phase and the housing located near the MCCB.
I need to see the side damage in the charger from the inside perspective, for this I would like to schedule a video call to proper investigate the damaged parts of the charger. Without this information, no conclusion can be provided from our side.
Feel free to reach out to me directly in case of questions or doubts.
Thank you and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
